k.store.meta_tip: Reads each game's cover and description from its page; they appear gradually
k.store.p.intro: PC games come from the stores installed on this computer and from linked accounts. Games that aren't installed appear with an «Install» button, which opens the store on the game's page.
k.store.p.legal: Only download what you have the right to download (games you own where a backup copy is allowed, freeware, demos): downloading protected games without a license is illegal.
k.store.p.others: Lists of PC games that are not official stores, in two categories: 📦 Repack (heavily compressed games, meant for people with a slow connection: the download is shorter but installation takes time) and ⬇ Direct download. Paste the address of a list page for each site: the app reads names and links and shows them among the PC games, with a button for each source.
k.store.p.ra: Achievements and progress for retro games appear on each game's page. Your Web API key is in your profile on retroachievements.org › Settings.
k.store.p.update: Read lists stay saved in the cache: on startup, store games are already there and the app can re-read the sites in the background. Several stores are read in parallel (one per site, so no server receives duplicate requests).
k.store.par_tip: How many different sites to read at the same time
k.store.probe_tip: Reads only this page and reports how many games and pages it has
k.store.run_tip: Adds all stores not yet read to the queue
k.stream.p.intro: Streaming uses Sunshine on the PC and Moonlight (free for Android, iPhone, tablet, TV, PC, Mac) wherever you want to play. Pozzo Launcher publishes Big Picture and your main games with their covers to Moonlight.
k.stream.play.nofind: If Moonlight can't find the PC: Sunshine is stopped (see above or Settings › System › Health), the PC and TV are on different networks, or the Windows firewall is blocking Sunshine on private networks.
k.stream.play.p1: Install Moonlight (App Store / Play Store) and pair the PC as above.
k.stream.play.p2: On-screen controls: Moonlight has virtual buttons over the video. On iPhone/iPad: Moonlight settings › On-Screen Controls › Full (always visible) or Auto (they disappear when you connect a controller). On Android: settings › Show on-screen controls.
k.stream.play.p3: Real controller: pair it via Bluetooth with the phone/iPad (PS5, PS4, Xbox, Switch Pro, MFi): Moonlight uses it automatically and hides the on-screen buttons.
k.stream.play.phone_ctrl: The phone as a controller, with the game on the PC monitor or on the TV connected to the PC: pair it in the app above and, on a game's page, choose Play with phone as controller (including gyroscope and multiple players).
k.stream.play.phone_head: On the phone or iPad, with the game on the phone's screen
k.stream.play.s1: On the PC: Sunshine must be running (button on this page; it stays active after restarts).
k.stream.play.s2: On the TV, install Moonlight: Android TV / Google TV / Fire TV from the store; Apple TV from the App Store; LG webOS and Samsung Tizen with community versions (Moonlight TV). Alternatively, a Chromecast with Google TV or a Fire TV Stick.
k.stream.play.s3: Pair the controller via Bluetooth to the TV (TV settings › Remotes & Accessories).
k.stream.play.s4: Open Moonlight: the PC appears by itself (same network). Select it and enter the PIN shown in the Sunshine web interface (link above, PIN tab).
k.stream.play.s5: Press Publish to Moonlight above, then in Moonlight choose Pozzo Launcher Big Picture or a game. Moonlight sends controller inputs to the PC, where Sunshine creates a virtual Xbox controller (ViGEmBus): for the emulator it's like a real controller.
k.stream.play.title: How to play: TV, phone, iPad
k.stream.play.tv_head: On the TV with a controller connected to the TV (the controller doesn't need to be connected to the PC)
k.stream.tip.box: A box instead of the TV's app: Nvidia Shield, Apple TV 4K or Google TV Streamer decode much faster than a smart TV.
k.stream.tip.cable: Cable on the TV or box too: if that's not possible, use 5 GHz or 6 GHz Wi-Fi close to the router, never 2.4 GHz.
k.stream.tip.gametv: TV Game Mode: turn it on (or «Low latency / ALLM»). On its own it often removes 30–60 ms.
k.stream.tip.moon: Moonlight, in settings: 60 fps (120 if the TV supports it), Frame pacing set to «Lowest latency» (or «Prefer lowest latency»), bitrate 20–40 Mbit/s at 1080p, HEVC only if the device decodes it in hardware.
k.stream.tip.stats: Statistics: in Moonlight, turn on the performance overlay. High «Host processing» = PC; high «Decoding» = TV/box; high «Network» = network.
k.stream.tip.usb: Controller via USB cable to the TV or box when possible: Bluetooth adds a few milliseconds.
k.stream.tips.sub: (where most of the time is lost)
k.stream.tips.title: Tips for TV, box and phone
k.sys.api.new_tip: The token changes: scripts already configured will stop working
k.sys.api.p: For scripts, Stream Deck, Home Assistant and webhooks: the /api/v1 endpoints stay the same across versions and require this token (Authorization: Bearer …). Examples and rules in the instructions.
k.sys.cache.p: Responses from RAWG, IGDB, HowLongToBeat and other sources, plus the LaunchBox database. Clearing them makes the app download them again on next use.
k.sys.diag.p: Local diagnostic log stored only on your computer (no data is sent to the cloud). You can view recent errors, copy the anonymized report, or clear the log.
k.sys.health.p: What's wrong and how to fix it. Checks run on the PC, with no online requests.
k.sys.storage.p: Metadata, covers and cache: where they are and how much space they take up.
